vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: 0xarchive
Version: 1.0.0

The skill is benign. It provides clear instructions and examples for an AI agent to query the 0xArchive API using `curl` and `jq` for crypto market data. All network calls are directed to `https://api.0xarchive.io`, and the API key (`$OXARCHIVE_API_KEY`) is handled securely via an environment variable. There is no evidence of malicious intent, data exfiltration, persistence mechanisms, obfuscation, or prompt injection attempts against the agent to perform actions beyond its stated purpose. The use of Bash and curl is appropriate for the skill's function.

llm.summary: The skill's requests and instructions match its stated purpose (calling the 0xArchive HTTP API with a single API key); nothing requested appears disproportionate or unrelated.

dimensions.detail: Name/description describe querying 0xArchive market data and the skill only requires an OXARCHIVE_API_KEY and curl-based HTTP requests to api.0xarchive.io — these are coherent and expected for this purpose.

llm.guidance: This skill is internally consistent: it only needs one API key (OXARCHIVE_API_KEY) to call the 0xArchive endpoints. Before installing, verify you trust the 0xArchive provider and that the API key you provide has minimal (read-only) scope and can be revoked if compromised. Be aware some endpoints (e.g., liquidations/user/{address}) can return user-specific data, so avoid using a key tied to privileged write or admin access. Because the skill is instruction-only and uses curl, no code will be installed on disk by the skill itself. If you want to limit autonomous calls, consider disabling autonomous invocation in your agent settings or only supply the API key at runtime when you intend to query data.
